t: The Phantom Dialogue: Scripting Demos to Prevent AI Regression
s: Addresses AI regression by implementing an interactive product demo, the 'Yellow Brick Road,' that acts as a scripted 'phantom dialogue' regression test. This system simulates user-AI interaction to ensure core functions remain robust against AI's tendency to revert to older states due to lack of persistent memory.
sub: AI regression due to lack of persistent state/memory.
Interactive product demos as regression testing ('Yellow Brick Road').
Phantom dialogue simulation between user and AI.
Cursor/Electron platform overload impacting AI responsiveness.
Branching strategy (`git checkout -b`) to preserve working states.
